dz: 君士坦丁堡人民对皇帝君士坦丁九世莫诺马霍斯发起骚乱，皇帝偏爱他的情妇玛丽亚·斯克勒莱娜而不是皇后佐伊·波菲罗格尼塔，这被视为一种侮辱。
de: The people of Constantinople riot against emperor Constantine IX Monomachos, whose preference of his mistress Maria Skleraina over empress Zoe Porphyrogenita is seen as an insult.
